authority: Konami official Yu-Gi-Oh! OCG Card Database and OCG supplementary rulings

cards.name: Nimble Momonga
cards.officialText: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Gain 1000 LP, then you can Special Summon any number of "Nimble Momonga" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.
cards.officialRuling: Mandatory GY trigger at the end of the Damage Step; not targeting. Gain 1000 LP first, then optionally Special Summon any number from the Deck in face-down Defense Position. These operations are not simultaneous.

cards.name: Giant Germ
cards.officialText: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent, then you can Special Summon any number of "Giant Germs" from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.
cards.officialRuling: Mandatory GY trigger at the end of the Damage Step; not targeting. Inflict 500 damage first, then optionally Special Summon any number from the Deck in face-up Attack Position. These operations are not simultaneous.

implementationNotes: Only battle destruction followed by sending to the GY triggers; destruction by effect or banishment does not.
The trigger is mandatory and activates in the GY at the end of the Damage Step; it does not target.
The LP gain/damage is resolved before the optional summon operation; the two operations are not simultaneous.
The optional summon count is any number, bounded by matching copies in the effect controller's own Deck and the remaining shared three Monster Zones.
Nimble Momonga summons face-down Defense Position; Giant Germ summons face-up Attack Position.

The physical owner of the destroyed trigger card is preserved separately from the effect controller. The LP team and Deck used for summons follow the effect controller at destruction; summoned copies retain the physical ownership of that controller seat.
scope: Isolated battle-destruction trigger planner, tests, official evidence and focused workflow only. No registry, catalog, certification, Discord command, persistent state or live duel integration.
certificationGate: Do not certify until the trigger is integrated into the Damage Step chain and the selected Deck cards are physically moved into the team's shared 3-zone field in complete 2v2 tests.
